item.title: “My Last Name Is Cooler”: 34 Women Give Reasons For Taking Or Not Taking Their Husband’s Surname
item.description: A lot of women are still obliged to take their husband’s last name after getting married, but more of them are challenging the norms. Some understand that their name is their identity, others don’t want to go through the hassle of all the paperwork, while many now realize it is undoubtedly a convention steeped in misogyny and patriarchy. A man recently asked women online what are the reasons for either keeping or changing their last names, and their replies did not disappoint.

item.title: 60 Photos That Show The Type Of Parents Everyone Wants For Themselves (New Pics)
item.description: Yes, parenting has its stressful and challenging moments. It requires a level of commitment that not everyone can meet, which is understandable. However, those who saw the lighter side of having kids have become the fun-loving parents that people tend to adore. Here are some examples that can be your source of good vibes today.

item.title: Man Takes Advantage Of Wife’s Submissive Nature, Cries Foul After She Stands Up For Herself
item.description: A marriage is supposed to be a two-way street. The moment one spouse begins to shoulder most of the burden is usually when cracks in the foundation begin to form. This is exactly what happened with this couple when the wife finally put her needs first after being her husband’s doormat for years. But instead of addressing the problem, the man began stonewalling her.

item.title: Boyfriend Gives Girlfriend Up To A Year To Fix Finances On Her Own Or He Won’t Marry Her
item.description: Money problems are often one of the biggest sources of conflict in a long-term relationship. Sometimes, you and your partner might not be on the same page about finances — Who pays what? Do we combine accounts or split bills evenly? Do we give each other “fun money” allowances or go strict with budgets? There’s no perfect formula, but laying it all out can give both partners a healthy starting point. item.title: “Always Having An Answer”: 41 Subtle, Surprising And Obvious Signs Of Very Low Intelligence
45 Stereotypes About Countries That Are Actually True
item.description: Stereotypes typically aren't a good thing. It's not fair to judge a person, place, or group of people based solely on what you've heard about them. Instead, we should let people show us and tell us who they are themselves. But according to this list, there are some stereotypes that just happen to be true. People from all over the world have been sharing stereotypes about their countries that are accurate, so we've gathered their most amusing replies right here.

item.title: 42 Of The Absolute Worst Valentine’s Day Stories Ever
item.description: February 14th is this week, and what’s often forgotten during this time of year is that both casual dates and serious relationships can be disappointing, too. So to reassure you that the most appropriate expectations for Valentine’s Day may be none at all, we compiled a collection of the worst experiences people have had while celebrating this special occasion. One has to wonder: what did they do to end up on Cupid’s naughty list?

item.title: “Memes For Mathematicians”: 80 Memes Nerds Will Probably Love
item.description: For some, doing math in school was the worst punishment they could think of. For others, it was like snapping their fingers. This post is dedicated to the latter, the mathematicians who like to spend their free time scrolling through even more math, even if in meme form. Check out these funniest posts from the "Memes for mathematicians" page on Instagram even if you're not a numbers and calculations nerd.

item.title: 60 Things That Are ‘Technically True’ And No One Can Argue With This Logic
item.description: If someone asked how many bones are in the human body and you answered “more than three,” you’d be right. Not helpful, a bit annoying, but still right—and honestly, kind of funny. We’ve rounded up some of the best cases of people online delivering that exact brand of technical correctness. There’s really nothing to argue with, so you might as well nod and laugh.

item.title: You Don’t Need To Be An 80s Baby To Recognize These Iconic Celebrity Faces
item.description: The 1980s were bigger than big hair, neon colors, and epic movie montages – they gave us the stars who defined a generation.From Madonna shocking audiences on MTV to Michael Jackson moonwalking into history to Prince’s unforgettable purple reign, this 29-question celebrity quiz will test your memory of the decade’s most unforgettable faces.If you think you can recognize the icons who ruled music, movies, and pop culture, this quiz will be a walk in the park for you.
